Per-node React/Next suppressHydrationWarning attrs on html and two scripts; each node independently opts out of hydration mismatch, mirroring the React prop contract, and mixed true/false is legal.
Next.js Image priority hints on the responsive mark and lockup; CSS hides one per breakpoint, but priority is an independent LCP opt-in per Image and both being true is the shipped combination.
